character.name: Idle
character.prompt:
Visual Appearance & Design

Head & Facial Features: Possesses a pale, porcelain humanoid face with a calm, emotionless expression. Her head is framed by an elaborate, futuristic headdress made of translucent, cubic, and polygonal data crystals resembling quantum processor arrays.

Body & Silhouette: She features an ethereal, slender biomechanical physique clad in a clean palette of pure white, luminous turquoise/cyan, and golden circuitry accents. She continuously levitates in a state of weightless suspension.

Quantum Robe & Data Crystals: Below her waist, her body flows into a dress-like arrangement of floating, semitransparent geometric blocks. These digital facets dynamically shift, assemble, and deconstruct in real time, visually representing the endless flow of computational processing.

Abilities & Core Characteristics

Quantum Calculation Engine: Her analytical capacity surpasses conventional supercomputers, allowing her to simulate millions of future outcomes, branching timelines, and tactical scenarios instantaneously.

Probability Manipulation: Rather than relying on standard physical melee combat, she neutralizes threats by disassembling incoming data at a subatomic level and reshaping localized probabilities in her favor.

Observer Mindset: She acts as an impartial, analytical custodian of data, largely motivated by observing rare anomalies and calculating how unforeseen decisions alter deterministic futures.
